title: Corporate Knowledge Assistant
summary: Project README defining the MVP goals, architecture, chosen stack, JEV role, and initial performance targets for a RAG assistant over financial/corporate documents with auth, RBAC, citations, and audit.
notes: Type set by manifest (PRD). Content also contains decision-like material ("Stack deciso": React/TS, Rust, PostgreSQL+pgvector, Argon2id, OpenAPI) and SPEC-like p95 performance targets; synthesizer may want to treat those as constraints. Output filename uses '-root' instead of the SHA-256 source_hash because no hashing tool was available to this classifier. Document is in Italian.
